target: templates/workflows/factory.js and skills/review/SKILL.md — no pr-close at all, while they do route through forge.sh
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"
J="$PLUGIN_ROOT/templates/workflows/factory.js"; R="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/review/SKILL.md"
fx_has "$J" 'pr-close' factory_prclose
fx_has "$R" 'pr-close' review_prclose
fx_has "$J" 'forge.sh' factory_forge
fx_has "$R" 'forge.sh' review_forge
